gaps.title: Non-autoregressive machine translation lags on long outputs
gaps.description: Reported speedups on WMT En-De largely vanish for long outputs, where the number of refinement passes needed grows with the target length.

user_input.title: My own idea — spend the passes where the entropy is
user_input.text: I keep coming back to this: don't budget passes by length, budget them by where the model is uncertain. Rare words and named entities are what stay wrong, and they cluster. A length-based budget spends compute on positions that were already correct after pass one.

user_input.title: Constraint from my setup
user_input.text: Whatever we do has to run on a single A100 and be reproducible from a public WMT checkpoint. I am not going to pretrain anything from scratch for this.

user_input.title: What I want out of this session
user_input.text: I want the entropy-allocation angle taken seriously, and I want to know what it would take to falsify it.

ideas.title: Confidence-Gated Parallel Decoding with a Length-Aware Step Budget
ideas.description: A non-autoregressive decoder whose refinement-pass budget is allocated from the predicted output length, with per-position confidence gating.

discussion.text: Earlier in the session the user rejected 'just train a bigger denoiser' as uninteresting — it does not explain why the speedup disappears, it only pushes the constant around.
